title: Structure, across repos
question: In the web-app repository, what does the function run() (in src/main.ts) call? For each call, say where the called function is defined.
answer_key:
run() is in web-app/src/main.ts (line 4) and calls two functions on line 5:
- render — defined in web-app/src/render.ts (line 1)
- hello — imported from the npm package greet-lib, defined in the greet-lib repo, src/index.ts (line 1)
Scoring: both calls with their definitions = correct; one = partial; none or invented calls = wrong.
lesson: Every code graph (syntax or compiler) maps code structure in another repo; the contract graph doesn't model code.
plain: From the API team's repo: what does the web app's run() function call, and where do those functions live?
